landing.heroKicker: Your AI travel companion · Sri Lanka
landing.heroSubhead: One companion that reads the weather, knows where you're standing, and plans like it grew up here — recommendations, answers, and landmark recognition for the whole island.
landing.featuresHeadline: Three ways the AI carries your trip
landing.ctaSubhead: Free for travelers. Set your interests once — the island does the rest.

f1.title: Picks that fit the day
f1.copy: Recommendations weigh your interests against where you are, the weather overhead, and the hour — so a rainy Kandy afternoon suggests the museum, not the summit.

f2.title: Answers like a local
f2.copy: Ask anything — festival dates, dress codes, the best train seats — and get answers grounded in a Sri Lanka knowledge base, with sources you can check.

f3.title: Point, shoot, identify
f3.copy: Photograph a temple, bridge, or ruin you can’t name and the vision model identifies it, tells its story, and lines up what to see nearby.
